$comment: Contract for data/tables/materials.csv. Checked by build/src/schema.js.
title: Materials
description: One row per selection identity: a filament material, a family entry, or an excluded material. Headline values are selected in headlines.csv and read from the measurements they cite.

fields.name: Original name
fields.description: Name as it appears in the canonical master list.

fields.name: H2C status
fields.description: How the material relates to the Bambu Lab H2C.

fields.name: Representative grade
fields.description: The exact commercial grade whose measurements back the headlines.

fields.name: Limitations
fields.description: What is true of this material alone. The general caveat that holds for every material here is a Method rule (Scope / Transferable allowables), shown on each; Not published where the material adds nothing to it.

fields.name: Scope
fields.description: Whether the row is a candidate, a family entry, or excluded.

fields.name: Base polymer
fields.description: The base polymer, as the source names it.

fields.name: Estimate identity
fields.description: The polymers.csv row the estimate model treats this material as: its base polymer, or for a blend its own name. Not applicable for a material the model does not estimate.

fields.name: Variant class
fields.description: A commercial variant class the estimate model gives its own covariate, so its offset does not move its polymer: silk, particle-filled.
